user.title: ESC/POS Thermal Printer Designer
user.description:
Design labels, lists and receipts in a web designer and print them on your ESC/POS thermal printers.

Found {printer_count} printer(s) in the ESC/POS Thermal Printer integration. If that's 0, add a printer there first - you can still finish this setup.

install_printer_integration.title: ESC/POS Thermal Printer integration needed
install_printer_integration.description:
The designer prints through the **ESC/POS Thermal Printer** integration, which isn't installed yet.

1. [Open it in HACS]({hacs_url}) and download it ([repository]({repository_url}); new to HACS? See the [HACS guide]({hacs_docs_url})).
2. Restart Home Assistant.
3. Come back to this dialog and select **Submit**.

error.printer_integration_missing: The ESC/POS Thermal Printer integration was not found. Install it through HACS and restart Home Assistant first.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The designer is already set up.

data.require_admin: Only administrators can use the designer

data_description.show_in_sidebar: Adds the designer to the Home Assistant sidebar.
data_description.require_admin: Templates can read entity states, so the designer is limited to administrators by default. Turn this off to let every household member design and print.

printer_integration_missing.title: ESC/POS Thermal Printer integration is not installed
printer_integration_missing.description: The designer prints through the ESC/POS Thermal Printer integration. [Open it in HACS]({hacs_url}), install it and restart Home Assistant.

no_printer_configured.title: No ESC/POS printer is set up yet
no_printer_configured.description: The designer is ready, but there is no printer to print on. Add your printer under Settings → Devices & services → ESC/POS Thermal Printer.
